label: LIS
subtitle: dp[i] = longest increasing subsequence ending at index i
useWhen: Pairs or envelopes sorted and nested
O(n log n) required: binary search + tails array
avoidWhen: Contiguous subarray needed (use Kadane's / sliding window)

stateTransition.code: O(n²): dp[i] = max(dp[j]+1) for all j<i where nums[j]<nums[i]
O(n log n): maintain tails[], binary search for insert position

problems.name: Longest Increasing Subsequence
problems.insight: O(n²) DP or O(n log n) patience sort

problems.name: Longest Bitonic Subsequence
problems.insight: LIS from left + LIS from right

problems.name: Maximum Length of Pair Chain
problems.insight: Sort by end, LIS on pairs

problems.name: Russian Doll Envelopes
problems.insight: Sort by w asc, h desc → LIS on h
